lines.latin: Ittihad Baladiyyat Qada' Sur (Union of Municipalities of Tyre District)
Kanisat al-Qiddis Tuma lil-Rum al-Kathulik (St Thomas Greek Catholic Church)

lines.text: بنيت الكنيسة حوالي العام 1752 م بتمويل من تاجر يدعى
lines.latin: Buniyat al-kanisa hawali al-'am 1752 m bi-tamwil min tajir yud'a (The church was built around 1752 funded by a merchant called)

lines.text: جرجس مشاقة. ولا يزال جزء من الكنيسة الصليبية محفوظا
lines.latin: Jirjis Mashaqa. Wa-la yazal juz' min al-kanisa al-salibiyya mahfuzan (George Mashaqa. Part of the Crusader church is still preserved)
Taht al-bina' al-hali. (under the current building.)

lines.text: Saint Thomas Apostle, Greek Catholic Melkite Church
The church was built around the year 1752
With the funding of a merchant named
George Mashakka. Still part of the church
Crusade preserved under the current construction

notes: Brown heritage information board at St Thomas Melkite cathedral, Tyre, frontal and sharp. The name panels are line 2 (Arabic) and line 6 (English); the rest is history text. Western digits 1752 in the Arabic paragraph.
source_categories: Melkite Greek Catholic Cathedral of Saint Thomas in Tyre
